version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: First public version.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Cue list: click a row to go to its cue, a Start row, + below, Use current view and Undo. Autoscroll: Smooth or Jump scrolling; toolbar in groups with icons and a Hide controls button. Clearer Settings and Help; Settings is a gear icon.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Settings and the page cache are now in REAPER's Data folder (Data\Chart Cue). During playback the autoscroll mode is locked and shown as text in the toolbar.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: 2 PDFs per song (for example lyrics and a bass part), shown together, each with its own cues. 2 pages side by side or continuous pages, with a slide-in page turn; folder sync and unused PDFs in the Library. Cleaner Settings and buttons, Redo for cues, right-click menus everywhere, and many fixes.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Setlist tab: your show order with Stop / Continue, pauses, several setlists, play buttons and a Next song action; the page area can show the setlist, the PDF, or both. Notes on the pages, a page-turn countdown, a brightness button, hideable toolbar items and tabs, Settings in 5 sections, shortcut assignment for the actions, a page cache limit, and many fixes.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Faster toolbar, safer cue lists for PDF 2, and preparation for a later UI scale setting. No visible changes.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: PNG and JPG images as charts; a marker list with Record, add buttons, colours and "Copy cues into markers". A new large setlist view (current song, time left, progress); REAPER stops at the exact end of a song. Tab icons and 2-line rows in a narrow window; numpad zoom keys; works together with the new Segue script.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Code clean-up with no visible change: settings and project values of old development versions are no longer read or written. Each existing project is marked as changed once, the next time Chart Cue saves it.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Questions open in a window in the centre of Chart Cue. Tooltips show after a short delay, with wrapped lines. Right-click menus on the panel, the tabs and the toolbar items (Hide ...); a Sync folder dropdown in the Library.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: A Light / Dark theme (Settings > Appearance > Theme); Dark stays the default. Darker panels for more contrast; the window title bar follows the theme.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Settings in the same order as Segue and MIDI Pilot: Appearance starts with Look (Theme, Comfortable layout). Settings > General: Window (Dock in docker, Reset window position) and Backup (Back up..., Restore..., Reset all settings...). A friendlier, easier Help.

reapack.name: MIDI Pilot.lua
reapack.desc: MIDI Pilot: MIDI editor for amp modelers (Quad Cortex, Line 6 Helix / HX)

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: First version (step 1): the window, the devices (Quad Cortex or mini, MIDI output and channel) and their tracks.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: The full first version (0.1 on ReaPack was an early build): presets and scenes by name at the song starts, knob values in real units with ramps and swells, nudge and latency, and the state at the song starts (Fill songs, Live chase, Send state).

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Line 6 Helix, HX Stomp, HX Stomp XL and HX Effects (untested); Add device lists connected units and all models. Quad Cortex: the 2 expression pedals per preset, the unit's footswitches, tuner, tap tempo, Gig View and mode in Lanes; a second preset inside a song. Show overview and Export MIDI (1 file for the show or per song); settings now save correctly; clearer Help.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: The scene strip is now called the scene timeline (Settings > Appearance > Scene timelines, Help).

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Faster input: keys 1-8 add a scene at the edit cursor; presets from region names ('Song [3B]') and markers ('P 3B'); markers from scenes; 1 preset for several songs (Ctrl+click). Preset settings and Scene settings: when the first preset and first scene come, and where added presets and scenes go (before, at or after; ms or note values). A Scene test ends with a normal scene change back to the scene before it; a clearer Tools menu.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Lanes: Add LFO (Sine, Triangle, Square, Saw; the rate follows the tempo; the peaks can grow or shrink); LFOs, ramps and swells show as 1 row that you can move, copy and paste; collapsible sections. A toolbar (device, previous / next song, Snap, Send state, Set up songs, Scene timelines, Export) and hideable tabs; Getting started; adds follow REAPER's Snap. Preset list search and sort; Settings in 4 sections with Back up / Restore; Preset and Scene always written with a capital.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Settings in the same order as Chart Cue: Look (Theme, Comfortable layout), Window (Reset window position), Backup (Reset all settings...); About at the end of Help. A right-click menu on the panel (Add Scene, Send state, Set up songs, Snap, toolbar, dock, close); compact spacing by default. A friendlier, easier Help.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: First version: setlists with Stop / Continue and pauses, the play buttons, a large "now playing" area, the lock, undo and the "Next song" action. REAPER stops at the exact end of a song.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Version 1.0: questions open in the centre of the window, and tooltips show after a short delay.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: A Light theme (gear menu > Light theme); Dark stays the default. Darker panels for more contrast; the window title bar follows the theme.

version.author: Nick Gkogkomitros
version.changelog: Gear menu in the order of the other scripts: Look, Window (Reset window position) and Backup (Back up, Restore, Reset all settings). A right-click menu on the panel (Settings, Help, dock, close). Help in topics, in a friendlier, easier style.
